root.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Spielmann Variation
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 e6 3. Nf3 Nf6 4. e3 c6 5. Nbd2 g6

overview: Black plays a Semi-Slav Quiet set-up with ...c6, ...e6 and ...g6, mixing a Slav centre with a Catalan-style fianchetto. White continues with Bd3, O-O and e4, or e4 with a small space plus. Black wants ...dxc4 and ...b5 or ...Bg7 and a solid position.

white_ideas.idea: Play e4 after Bd3 and O-O for central space
Keep pieces coordinated with Nbd2 and Qc2

typical_structures.structure: Slav-QGD pawn structure with ...c6/...d5/...e6 and a fianchettoed bishop

character.notes: Closed-ish pawn centre and slow manoeuvring; Black's position is hard to attack.

structure.notes: The centre stays in tension with d5 and d4 facing each other.

approach.notes: An accepted but less common branch of the Semi-Slav.

sublines_that_differ.name: 5...Bd6 main Quiet Variation
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 e6 3. Nf3 Nf6 4. e3 c6 5. Nbd2 Bd6
sublines_that_differ.how: More central than the g6 set-up.

character.reason: Slav-type pawn wall with a fianchetto, few early tactics.

soundness.reason: A reasonable and playable Black structure.

structure.reason: Centre tension with d5/d4 remains undecided.

plans.reason: Black fianchettoes and has to find a role for the c8-bishop behind the pawns.
